#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

class Test {
public:
    int readInt() {
        int val = 0;
        bool negFlag = false;
        char ch;
        while (cin.get(ch)) {
            if (ch == '-') {
                negFlag = true;
                break;
            } else if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
                val = ch - '0';
                while (cin.get(ch) && ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    val = val * 10 + (ch - '0');
                }
                if (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
                    cin.unget();
                }
                break;
            }
        }
        return negFlag ? -val : val;
    }

    int R, C;
    vector<char> sequenceChars;
    vector<vector<long>> pascal;
    long minDist;
    vector<int> countA, countB;
    map<long, long> cacheMap;

    long explorePaths(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long diff = labs(x - y);
        if (minDist <= 1 || diff - pascal[v1][R] * pascal[v2][R] >= minDist) return LLONG_MAX;
        if (v1 == R - 1 && v2 == R - 1) {
            if (diff < minDist) minDist = diff;
            return LLONG_MAX;
        }
        long res = LLONG_MAX;
        if (v1 >= R) {
            long deltaX = pascal[v1][R] - pascal[v1 - 1][R], deltaY = pascal[v2][R];
            res = min(res, explorePaths(x, y + deltaX * deltaY, v1 - 1, v2));
        }
        if (v2 >= R) {
            long deltaX = pascal[v1][R], deltaY = pascal[v2][R] - pascal[v2 - 1][R];
            res = min(res, explorePaths(x + deltaX * deltaY, y, v1, v2 - 1));
        }
        return res;
    }

    long computeSolution(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long key = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
        auto it = cacheMap.find(key);
        if (it != cacheMap.end()) return it->second;
        long res = 0;
        long d = labs(x - y);
        if (d - pascal[v1][R] * pascal[v2][R] > minDist) {
            cacheMap[key] = res;
            return res;
        }
        if (v1 < R || v2 < R) {
            int sumIdx = v1 + v2;
            if (v1 >= countA[sumIdx] && v2 >= countB[sumIdx]) {
                v1 -= countA[sumIdx];
                v2 -= countB[sumIdx];
                res = pascal[v1 + v2][v1];
                cacheMap[key] = res;
                return res;
            }
            cacheMap[key] = res;
            return res;
        }
        char c = sequenceChars[v1 + v2 - 1];
        if (c != 'B') {
            long c1 = pascal[v1][R] - pascal[v1 - 1][R], s2 = pascal[v2][R];
            res += computeSolution(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (c != 'A') {
            long s1 = pascal[v1][R], c2 = pascal[v2][R] - pascal[v2 - 1][R];
            res += computeSolution(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        cacheMap[key] = res;
        return res;
    }

    void run() {
        R = readInt(); C = readInt();
        string seqLine;
        getline(cin, seqLine);
        sequenceChars.assign(seqLine.begin(), seqLine.end());

        int size = 2 * (R + C) + 1;
        pascal.assign(size + 1, vector<long>(size + 1, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i <= size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= size; j++) {
                if (j == 0) pascal[i][j] = 1;
                else if (i == 0) pascal[i][j] = 0;
                else pascal[i][j] = pascal[i - 1][j - 1] + pascal[i - 1][j];
            }
        }

        int v1 = R + C, v2 = R + C;
        long xCoord = 0, yCoord = 0;
        while (v1 >= R && v2 >= R) {
            if (xCoord > yCoord) {
                long c1 = pascal[v1][R] - pascal[v1 - 1][R], s2 = pascal[v2][R];
                yCoord += c1 * s2;
                v1--;
            } else {
                long s1 = pascal[v1][R], c2 = pascal[v2][R] - pascal[v2 - 1][R];
                xCoord += s1 * c2;
                v2--;
            }
        }
        minDist = labs(xCoord - yCoord);
        explorePaths(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
        countA.assign(size + 1, 0);
        countB.assign(size + 1, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (R + C); i++) {
            countA[i + 1] = countA[i] + (sequenceChars[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            countB[i + 1] = countB[i] + (sequenceChars[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        long answer = computeSolution(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
        cout << answer << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    Test t;
    t.run();
    return 0;
}
